brief:
Istanbul's bar association has submitted six new evidence files to the International Criminal Court in The Hague, Shehab Wire reported. The dossiers contain documentation related to allegations of genocide, crimes against humanity, and war crimes attributed to occupation officials.

The submission represents a formal legal step in ongoing efforts to pursue accountability through international judicial channels. The Istanbul bar association compiled the materials as part of efforts to support Palestinian cases before the ICC, adding to previous submissions related to the armed conflict in Gaza.
